about: One-way fingerprints of long texts and keywords from the version 1.4.1 sample, which shipped in plain text. build_workiq.py and count_signals.py refuse configs and keywords that copy them. Nothing here comes from anyone's current work, and short names or numbers are never fingerprinted. Under "sample": one-way fingerprints of the fictional Sam Taylor sample (its email keys, calendar items, file ids and dates, and keyword alternatives), so the scripts refuse the sample, and copies of its keywords, without shipping its raw data.
